title: Remove the leftover Beads/Dolt rules from Engram's .gitignore
outcome: Engram's .gitignore no longer carries the Beads/Dolt block that an old bd init added, since this repository tracks its work in Engram and has no .beads directory.
acceptance: The '# Beads / Dolt files (added by bd init)' block and its .dolt/, .beads-credential-key and .beads/proxieddb/ rules are removed from .gitignore
git status shows no newly untracked files as a result

completion.summary: .gitignore no longer carries the Beads/Dolt block (.dolt/, .beads-credential-key, .beads/proxieddb/); *.db stays under its own comment, so no SQLite store becomes visible; no file became untracked in the worktree or the main checkout. Store judgment: none; readiness ready on all 4 stores.
